name: NecroCode Code Exorcist — Stage Hooks
description: Trigger hooks that fire on each visual exorcism stage transition in the Haunted Node Graph. Mapped 1:1 to WORKFLOW_STAGES in lib/types.ts. Each hook drives node highlighting (blood-red when haunted, spectral when cleansed) and the séance SFX.

hooks.name: on-run-start
hooks.description: Fires when the user clicks 'Run Bug Exorcism'. Lights the candles and resets the haunted node graph.

hooks.name: on-input-code
hooks.description: Highlights the Input Code node while the cursed snippet is parsed.

hooks.name: on-glitch-scanner
hooks.description: The Glitch Scanner hunts for demons. On detection the node pulses blood-red (haunted).

hooks.name: on-exorcism-reasoning
hooks.description: Reasons about each haunting and banishes it; a neon trail flows toward the output node.

hooks.name: on-clean-output
hooks.description: Streams the purified code; the node turns spectral green (cleansed).

hooks.name: on-run-complete
hooks.description: Fires when the exorcism reaches Complete. All demons banished, the crypt rests.
